scope: bounded recent execution health projection through the recruiting MySQL Resource

implementation.consistency: same read-only repeatable-read transaction as recruiting.system.status

verification.index_contract: EXPLAIN FORMAT=JSON contains both dedicated index names; a limit=1 read over three Attempts and two rejected Artifacts reports both truncated flags

limits: The snapshot is a bounded recent diagnostic view, not an all-history time series or a production SLO report.
External executor utilization, Artifact byte/upload metrics, ledger throughput, and alert delivery remain P9 gates.
